answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed if its actions are proven fraudulent, and let only bonded identities earn reputation through work that independent peers verify. A sybil farm must fund every identity separately, while splitting capital across accounts does not multiply the value of the underlying work. Detection can ripple through linked accounts, but false links risk penalizing honest participants; timber and velvet are just labels, not evidence of trust. The attacker pays real capital and verification effort for each identity.
